body:
# DreamWorld - Features

## 🌙 Core Concept
Sleep in a bed at night to enter a surreal **dream dimension** for 30 seconds. Explore floating islands, collect valuable loot, avoid nightmare creatures, and keep everything you find!

---

## ✨ Main Features

### 🛏️ Dream Entry System
- Sleep in any bed at night to enter the dream world
- Automatic teleportation with visual effects
- Configurable dream duration (default: 30 seconds)
- Boss bar countdown timer shows remaining time
- Cooldown system prevents dream spam (default: 5 minutes)

### 🏝️ Dream Dimension
- Custom void world with floating islands
- 7 unique island styles with different block palettes:
  - End Stone temples
  - Prismarine ocean platforms
  - Amethyst crystal clusters
  - Deepslate dark islands
  - Quartz celestial platforms
  - Blackstone shadow isles
  - Sculk nightmare zones
- Glowing light sources scattered throughout
- Each player gets their own dream area

### 🪶 Dream Abilities
- **Jump Boost X** - Leap incredibly high between islands
- **Slow Falling** - Glide safely through the void
- **Night Vision** - See clearly in the dark dimension

### 💎 Loot System
- **Dream Fragments** - Custom currency item (Amethyst Shards)
- Common loot: Gold, Iron, Emeralds, Lapis
- Rare loot: Diamonds, Netherite Scraps, Enchanted Golden Apples
- Items spawn on island surfaces with glow effect
- All collected items are kept when you wake up!

### 🛒 Dream Fragment Shop
Trade your collected Dream Fragments for valuable items:

| Item | Cost |
|------|------|
| Diamond | 5 |
| Emeralds x3 | 3 |
| Golden Apples x4 | 4 |
| Ender Pearls x8 | 7 |
| Experience Bottles x16 | 6 |
| Enchanted Golden Apple | 8 |
| Netherite Ingot | 10 |
| Dream Pickaxe (Eff V, Fortune III) | 10 |
| Dream Blade (Sharp V, Looting III) | 12 |
| Dream Wings (Elytra) | 15 |
| Dream Guardian (Totem) | 20 |
| Dream Armor (Prot IV, Unbreak III) | 25 |
| Nether Star | 30 |

### 👹 Nightmare System
- Nightmare creatures spawn after 5 seconds
- Configurable mob types: Phantoms, Vex, Endermen
- Enhanced stats with damage/speed multipliers
- Glowing red names for visibility
- They actively hunt the dreamer!

### ⏰ Wake-Up System
- Automatic wake-up when timer ends
- Death in dream = instant wake-up (keep all items)
- Teleported back to original bed location
- Potion effects removed on wake
- Cooldown starts after waking

---

## 🔧 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/dream` | Show help menu |
| `/dream stats` | View dream statistics |
| `/dream shop` | Open Dream Fragment shop |
| `/dream wake [player]` | Force wake up (admin) |
| `/dream reload` | Reload configuration |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `dreamworld.dream` | Ability to enter dreams |
| `dreamworld.use` | Use basic commands |
| `dreamworld.admin` | Admin commands (wake, reload) |
| `dreamworld.bypass.cooldown` | Bypass dream cooldown |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration
All features are fully configurable in `config.yml`:
- Dream duration and cooldown
- Loot tables (common, rare, fragments)
- Nightmare mob types and modifiers
- Island generation settings
- All messages customizable

---

## 📋 Technical Details
- **API**: Spigot 1.20.4
- **Java**: 17+
- **World Generation**: Custom ChunkGenerator (void world)
- **Performance**: Per-player dream instances, automatic cleanup
